profile.headline: Building Autonomous Agent Teams | Senior Engineer & Tech Lead @ JPMC | Open to AI Conversations
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Ishmell — a Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead at JPMorgan Chase, where I lead a team of 5 engineers and build software. Most of my recent work centers on agentic AI: I architected an in-house MCP-based development platform that's now used by senior leadership across the firm, and I'm currently leading a brownfield app being built end-to-end by the platform under engineer-led review. My stack spans React, Next.js, Spring Boot, Flask, Java, Python, Kafka, Oracle DB, AWS, and the modern AI tooling layer (MCP, Claude, Copilot). I'm passionate about creative problem-solving, raising engineering velocity through new tooling, and aspire to live and create every day.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Technical Lead
positions.description:
Drove adoption of agentic AI workflows across the team by designing and shipping an MCP-based development platform integrating with IntelliJ, Copilot, and Claude; automated routine implementation, testing, and PR/Jira orchestration to expedite ~50 story points per sprint while maintaining engineer-led review and ticket refinement.

Lead delivery of a brownfield application integrating with a major external partner — built end-to-end by the in-house agentic platform under engineer-led review, serving as a real-world validation of the tooling and a proof point informing rollout to other teams.

Drive AI adoption across the broader organization — demoing the agentic development platform directly to senior leadership, who have begun using the tool and committed to expanding rollout across their teams.

Trusted as the team’s technical interviewer for engineering hires across both current and prior role, evaluating candidates’ coding and problem-solving skills to inform hiring decisions.

Led cloud modernization of a legacy application on AWS — architecting the target-state system in React and Spring, defining UI and API specifications, and partnering with Product and UI/UX to align on stakeholder priorities.

Defined project timelines and user stories, distributing work across the team to maintain delivery cadence.

Mentored junior engineers in React, Spring, and modern practices, improving team-wide velocity.
positions.insights: Engineering Leadership, Technical Project Leadership and +2 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer | Technical Lead
positions.description:
Conceived a product idea, recruited and led a cross-functional team through an internal hackathon to deliver a working proof-of-concept, and secured a direct demo with the CTO to socialize the work at the executive level.

Set technical direction for a previous team’s modernization initiative, defining architecture and breaking down delivery into actionable workstreams for engineers.

Partnered closely with Product and UI/UX leadership to translate stakeholder priorities into technical roadmaps.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Initiated a UI/UX design effort for the team, producing Figma mockups to align engineering and product on user experience direction, and built a micro frontend proof-of-concept to validate the architectural approach.

Developed a front-end application for capturing user acknowledgment using Next.js, including a dashboard for 
feature engagement tracking.

Built microservices communicating via Kafka and REST APIs using Spring Boot and Oracle DB.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, built, and deployed mobile applications using MySQL, REST APIs via Flask, and Xamarin.

Developed web scrapers using Python and C#.

Designed, created, and maintained containerized web applications for e-commerce using Docker, MySQL, React, ASP.NET, and Nginx on a CentOS 7 server.

positions.title: Solutions Specialist
positions.description: Led team initiatives, assumed management responsibilities in the absence of management, and ensured the entire team was kept current on new and emerging technologies
